findings.summary: newest_covering_review returns None when any single covering record carries neither a timestamp nor a readable plan commit, so an answer to the only covering review is refused; the plan states the refusal remains only when two covering reviews cannot be ordered, and before this change a lone covering review was answered. Reachable only through a hand-written record, because store_plan_review stamps every record it writes.

the covering set filters out every design review and then appends only newest_design_review, so --review-run naming an older design review of the plan is now refused with 'does not raise finding', where the plan requires --review-run to accept any delivered review of the plan that raises the named finding and the previous candidate set included it.
